product.name: Planlens
product.summary: Paid Cursor/VS Code extension that reviews Terraform/OpenTofu plan JSON locally.

version.vsix_note: 0.1.4 packed with Copy Diagnostics. HAT was on 0.1.3; Copy Diagnostics is Low/Medium — clipboard only, no HAT required.

privacy.planlens_http: POST https://api.polar.sh/v1/customer-portal/license-keys/validate with {key, organization_id} only on license entry or Pro command when org id is set

watch.capability: Public changelogs only until GitHub repo + gh auth + Polar org id exist. Cloud vs local execution is undemonstrated — see LAUNCH.md.

deferred_tests: Run Plan against a real terraform/tofu binary in a trusted throwaway folder
Polar license validation with a real granted key
known_risks: Silent client failures are invisible without telemetry. Accepted.
PATH hijack outside the workspace is treated like a terminal. Disclosed, not Authenticode.
Run Plan executes provider plugins in the working directory. No apply.
Marketplace discovery is the main business failure mode.
launch_blockers: Public GitHub repository with Issues enabled, SECURITY.md, issue templates, and URL written into STATE.json, package.json bugs.url, site, README — repo created; push pending if files not on GitHub yet
Cursor daily watch automation created from ops/WATCH.md (owner one-time)

ops/LAUNCH.md proofs passed and recorded in ops/watch/PROOF.json (unattended loop: Cursor closed, machine asleep/offline/restarted, failed scheduled run; plus one harmless GitHub→watch simulated incident). Interactive watch runs do not count.
Polar organization id recorded; checkout URL recorded; neither baked into package.json or public site yet
Microsoft VS Code Marketplace publisher agreement + listing
LICENSE / publisher legal name before public listing
Deferred tests still open: real terraform Run Plan; real Polar granted key

hurdle.kill_if: 90 days after listing: ~0 installs → kill discovery; installs ≥100 and 0 orders → pivot/kill; 1–4 orders → +30 days if reviews are not hostile; ≥5 paid and no security incident → continue

next_owner_action: After GitHub files are on origin: Polar Account Review → Add product website = https://github.com/PixelPounder/planlens (the repo, not a bought domain). Do not add a personal support email. Do not Submit for review. Do not list.
next_agent_action_after_github_push: Confirm Issues templates and SECURITY.md on origin. Private vulnerability reporting if the API allows. Then Polar website field. Support email and Submit for review stay later.
